result_text:
The export now builds the `all_files.zip` entries from the configured aspect names, so renaming `buildAndDeployment` no longer breaks the export.

**Change** (`reports/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/reports/dataexporters/DataExporter.java`):
- The zip block in `exportJson()` no longer hard-codes the five `aspect_*.txt` names. It calls a new private helper, `getScopeFileListEntry(aspect)`, once per scope (main, test, generated, build and deployment, other), in the same order as before.
- The helper names the entry and reads its source file with `DataExportUtils.getAspectFileListFileName(aspect, "")`, the same call the loose-file writer uses. The name and the file always match.

With the default config the entries are unchanged. With `buildAndDeployment` renamed, the fourth entry becomes `aspect_buildAndDeployment.txt`, and `git-history.zip` is written again because the exception no longer aborts the block first.

**Verification:** the `reports` module compiles offline (`BUILD SUCCESS`). No existing test covers `DataExporter`, so I did not run an export against a renamed config.

**Not changed:** the `try/catch (Throwable)` around the export still only prints a stack trace. Any future failure in this block will still be silent in the same way. I left it alone to keep the change small.
